# Prep workspace
```{r}
plotdir <- here("data", "manuscript", "figure2_asv")

dir.create(plotdir,
           recursive = TRUE,
           showWarnings = FALSE)

tabledir <- here("data", "manuscript", "tables")

dir.create(tabledir,
           recursive = TRUE,
           showWarnings = FALSE)

outdir <- here("data", "phyloseq")

dir.create(outdir,
           recursive = TRUE,
           showWarnings = FALSE)

# Change these to the exact labels in your metadata
sex_reference <- 0
sex_comparison <- 1

# phyloseq object
ps <- readRDS(file = here("data/dada2/ps_ASVs.rds"))

# extract metadata
metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps))

# filter "healthy" participants
metadata_healthy <- metadata %>%
  filter(Anamnesis == '0') %>%
  filter(Breast_disease == '0') %>%
  filter(Combined_disease == '0') %>%
  filter(Deficiency_of_G6PD == '0') %>%
  filter(GDM == '0') %>%
  filter(HDP == '0') %>%
  filter(Hepatopathy == '0') %>%
  filter(Hysteromyoma == '0') %>%
  filter(Infection == '0') %>%
  filter(Intrahepatic_cholestasis_of_pregnancy == '0') %>%
  filter(Ovary_disease == '0') %>%
  filter(Pelvic_adhesions == '0') %>%
  filter(Scar_uterus == '0') %>%
  filter(Streptococcal_infection == '0') %>%
  filter(Thalassemia == '0') %>%
  filter(Thyroid_disease == '0') %>%
  filter(Uteroplacental_insufficiency == '0') %>%
  filter(Medication_use == '0') %>%
  filter(Progesterone_use == '0') %>%
  filter(Twins == '0') %>%
  filter(Hypertension == '1' | Hypertension == '2') %>%
  drop_na(Infant_gender) %>%
  drop_na(BMI_before_pregnancy) %>%
  drop_na(Residency_status) %>%
  drop_na(Gestation_week) %>%
  drop_na(Parity) %>%
  drop_na(Age) %>%
  mutate(Infant_gender = as.factor(Infant_gender)) %>%
  mutate(Infant_gender = as.factor(case_when(Infant_gender == 1 ~ 0,
                                             Infant_gender == 2 ~ 1)))# %>%
  # mutate(BMI_before_pregnancy = scale(BMI_before_pregnancy)) %>%
  # mutate(Residency_status = as.factor(Residency_status)) %>%
  # mutate(Gestation_week = scale(Gestation_week)) %>%
  # mutate(Parity = scale(Parity)) %>%
  # mutate(Age = scale(Age)) %>%
  # mutate(Sex_Residency = paste0(Infant_gender, Residency_status))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert continuous variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------

metadata_healthy$Gestation_week <- as.numeric(
  metadata_healthy$Gestation_week
)

metadata_healthy$Age <- as.numeric(
  metadata_healthy$Age
)

metadata_healthy$BMI_before_pregnancy <- as.numeric(
  metadata_healthy$BMI_before_pregnancy
)

metadata_healthy$Parity <- as.numeric(
  metadata_healthy$Parity
)


# # ------------------------------------------------------------
# # Center continuous variables
# #
# # Centering is useful because fetal-sex main
# # effect is interpreted at mean gestational age.
# # ------------------------------------------------------------
# 
# metadata_healthy$gest_week_c <-
#   metadata_healthy$Gestation_week -
#   mean(
#     metadata_healthy$Gestation_week,
#     na.rm = TRUE
#   )
# 
# metadata_healthy$age_c <-
#   metadata_healthy$Age -
#   mean(
#     metadata_healthy$Age,
#     na.rm = TRUE
#   )
# 
# metadata_healthy$bmi_c <-
#   metadata_healthy$BMI_before_pregnancy -
#   mean(
#     metadata_healthy$BMI_before_pregnancy,
#     na.rm = TRUE
#   )
# 
# metadata_healthy$parity_c <-
#   metadata_healthy$Parity -
#   mean(
#     metadata_healthy$Parity,
#     na.rm = TRUE
#   )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Center & scale continuous variables
# so we can compare effect sizes of ega & fetal sex
# ------------------------------------------------------------

metadata_healthy$gest_week_s <-
  scale(metadata_healthy$Gestation_week)

metadata_healthy$age_s <-
  scale(metadata_healthy$Age)

metadata_healthy$bmi_s <-
  scale(metadata_healthy$BMI_before_pregnancy)

metadata_healthy$parity_s <-
  (metadata_healthy$Parity)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fetal sex
# ------------------------------------------------------------

metadata_healthy$fetal_sex <- factor(
  metadata_healthy$Infant_gender
)

message("Observed fetal-sex levels:")
print(
  levels(metadata_healthy$fetal_sex)
)

if (
  !sex_reference %in%
    levels(metadata_healthy$fetal_sex)
) {
  stop(
    "sex_reference = '",
    sex_reference,
    "' was not found in Infant_gender."
  )
}

if (
  !sex_comparison %in%
    levels(metadata_healthy$fetal_sex)
) {
  stop(
    "sex_comparison = '",
    sex_comparison,
    "' was not found in Infant_gender."
  )
}

# metadata_healthy$fetal_sex <- relevel(
#   metadata_healthy$fetal_sex,
#   ref = sex_reference
# )

# 0 = reference sex
# 1 = comparison sex
metadata_healthy$fetal_sex_binary <- ifelse(
  metadata_healthy$fetal_sex == sex_comparison,
  1,
  0
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Sex x gestational-age interaction
# ------------------------------------------------------------

metadata_healthy$sex_x_ega <-
  metadata_healthy$fetal_sex_binary *
  metadata_healthy$gest_week_s


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Categorical adjustment covariates
# ------------------------------------------------------------

metadata_healthy$Residency_status <- factor(
  metadata_healthy$Residency_status
)

# create phyloseq object with only healthy samples
ps.healthy <- ps
sample_data(ps.healthy) <- metadata_healthy

# save ps.healthy
saveRDS(ps.healthy, file = here("data/phyloseq/ps_healthy.rds"))
```


# CSS normalize all asvs
```{r}
# Normalize data CSS
ps_css<-ps.healthy
mg1<-phyloseq_to_metagenomeSeq(ps.healthy)
mg2<-metagenomeSeq::filterData (mg1, present = 1) 
p = metagenomeSeq::cumNormStatFast(mg2)
mg2 <- metagenomeSeq::cumNorm(mg2, p =p) 
otu_table_ps_css= metagenomeSeq::MRcounts(mg2 , norm = TRUE, log = FALSE)
otu_table_ps_css<-apply(otu_table_ps_css,c(1,2),function(x){round(x,0)})
otu_table(ps_css)<-otu_table(otu_table_ps_css, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
write.table(otu_table_ps_css,
            file=here("data/phyloseq/otu_table_ps_all_css.txt"),
            sep="\t",col.names = TRUE, row.names = TRUE)
saveRDS(ps_css, file=here("data/phyloseq/ps_all_css.rds"))

nrow(ps_css@otu_table)
ncol(ps_css@otu_table)

# use this as input for picrust2 - process using prep_picrust_from_phyloseq_css.rmd
```

# Filter data

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Start with healthy samples
# ============================================================

ps3 <- ps.healthy

cat(
  "Starting:",
  ntaxa(ps3), "ASVs,",
  nsamples(ps3), "samples\n"
)

# ============================================================
# 1. Remove ASVs with zero counts across all samples
# ============================================================

ps3 <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(ps3) > 0,
  ps3
)

cat(
  "After removing zero-total ASVs:",
  ntaxa(ps3), "ASVs,",
  nsamples(ps3), "samples\n"
)

# ============================================================
# 2. Remove ASVs with less than 10 counts in at least 1 sample
# ============================================================

otu_mat <- as(
  otu_table(ps3),
  "matrix"
)

if (!taxa_are_rows(ps3)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

keep_asv <- apply(
  otu_mat,
  1,
  function(x) {
    any(x >= 10, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
)

ps4 <- prune_taxa(
  keep_asv,
  ps3
)

# ============================================================
# 3. Remove low-abundance ASVs
#
# Keep an ASV if it reaches >= 0.1% relative abundance
# in at least one sample
# ============================================================

ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(
  ps4,
  function(x) {
    if (sum(x) == 0) {
      return(x)
    }

    x / sum(x)
  }
)

keep_taxa <- apply(
  as(otu_table(ps_rel), "matrix"),
  if (taxa_are_rows(ps_rel)) 1 else 2,
  function(x) {
    any(x >= 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
)

ps5 <- prune_taxa(
  keep_taxa,
  ps4
)

cat(
  "After abundance filter:",
  ntaxa(ps5), "ASVs,",
  nsamples(ps5), "samples\n"
)

# ============================================================
# 4. Remove samples with fewer than 2 remaining ASVs
# ============================================================

otu_mat <- as(
  otu_table(ps5),
  "matrix"
)

if (!taxa_are_rows(ps5)) {
  otu_mat <- t(otu_mat)
}

n_ASVs_per_sample <- colSums(
  otu_mat > 0,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

samples_to_remove <- names(
  n_ASVs_per_sample[
    n_ASVs_per_sample < 2
  ]
)

cat(
  "Samples with <2 ASVs:",
  length(samples_to_remove),
  "\n"
)

if (length(samples_to_remove) > 0) {
  print(samples_to_remove)
}

ps6 <- prune_samples(
  n_ASVs_per_sample >= 2,
  ps5
)

cat(
  "Final:",
  ntaxa(ps6), "ASVs,",
  nsamples(ps6), "samples\n"
)

```

## CSS normalize filtered data
```{r}
# ============================================================
# CSS
# ============================================================
ps_css<-ps6
mg1<-phyloseq_to_metagenomeSeq(ps6)
mg2<-metagenomeSeq::filterData (mg1, present = 1) 
p = metagenomeSeq::cumNormStatFast(mg2)
mg2 <- metagenomeSeq::cumNorm(mg2, p =p) 
otu_table_ps_css= metagenomeSeq::MRcounts(mg2 , norm = TRUE, log = FALSE)
otu_table_ps_css<-apply(otu_table_ps_css,c(1,2),function(x){round(x,0)})
otu_table(ps_css)<-otu_table(otu_table_ps_css, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
write.table(otu_table_ps_css,
            file=file.path(outdir,'otu_table_ps_css.txt'),
            sep="\t",col.names = TRUE, row.names = TRUE)
saveRDS(ps_css, file=file.path(outdir, 'ps_css.rds'))

print(paste0("OTU table rows: ", nrow(ps_css@otu_table)))
print(paste0("OTU table cols: ", ncol(ps_css@otu_table)))
```

```{r}
tax_table <- tax_table(ps_css)
# Convert taxonomy table to data frame for easier manipulation
tax_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table)

# Replace "p__" with "unspecified" in the taxonomy table
tax_df <- apply(tax_df, MARGIN = 2, function(x) gsub("^p__", "unspecified", x))

# Convert back to taxonomy table class
tax_table(ps_css) <- tax_df

#Step 2: Taxa agglomerate
####################################################################
ps_phylum <- tax_glom(ps_css, "Phylum")

#Step 3: Plot abundances
####################################################################
taxa_names(ps_phylum) <- phyloseq::tax_table(ps_phylum)[, "Phylum"]
p_phyla <- psmelt(ps_phylum) %>%
  ggplot(data = ., aes(x = Infant_gender, y = Abundance)) +
    #geom_boxplot(outlier.shape  = NA) +
    geom_violin() +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = OTU), height = 0, width = .2) +
    labs(x = "", y = "CSS Normalized Abundance", angle = 45) +
    facet_wrap(~ OTU, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Male", "Female")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust=0.5))+
  stat_compare_means()

ggsave(file.path(plotdir, "phylum_abundance.png"), plot = p_phyla, dpi = 600, 
       width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", limitsize = FALSE)
```

## Alpha diveristy
```{r}
richness=estimate_richness(ps_css, split = TRUE, measures = c("Shannon", "InvSimpson", "Chao1"))
richness=data.frame(sample_data(ps_css),richness,stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
richness[,"fetal_sex_binary"]<-as.factor(sample_data(ps_css)$fetal_sex_binary)
richness[,"Residency_status"]<-as.factor(sample_data(ps_css)$Residency_status)
richness[,"parity_s"]<-sample_data(ps_css)$parity_s
richness[,"gest_week_s"]<-sample_data(ps_css)$gest_week_s
richness[,"age_s"]<-sample_data(ps_css)$age_s
richness[,"bmi_s"]<-sample_data(ps_css)$bmi_s

richness_pvalues<-c()
aa<-summary(lm(Chao1 ~ fetal_sex_binary + Residency_status + parity_s + gest_week_s
        + age_s + bmi_s + fetal_sex_binary*gest_week_s, data=richness))
               
richness_pvalues<-rbind(richness_pvalues,
                      cbind(Method=rep("Chao1",nrow(aa$coefficients)),aa$coefficients))

aa<-summary(lm(Shannon ~fetal_sex_binary + Residency_status + parity_s + gest_week_s
        + age_s + bmi_s + fetal_sex_binary*gest_week_s, data=richness))
richness_pvalues<-rbind(richness_pvalues,
                    cbind(Method=rep("Shannon",nrow(aa$coefficients)),aa$coefficients))

aa<-summary(lm(InvSimpson ~ fetal_sex_binary + Residency_status + parity_s + gest_week_s
        + age_s + bmi_s + fetal_sex_binary*gest_week_s, data=richness))

richness_pvalues<-rbind(richness_pvalues,cbind(Method=rep("InvSimpson",nrow(aa$coefficients)),aa$coefficients))


richness_pvalues[rownames(richness_pvalues) %in% c("fetal_sex_bin","fetal_sex_binary:gest_week_s"),]

richness_pvalues[as.numeric(richness_pvalues[,"Pr(>|t|)"])<0.01,]

# no difference in diversity except for residency status for Chao1
#      Method Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)
#                   Method       Estimate           Std. Error           t value            Pr(>|t|)               
# (Intercept)       "Chao1"      "153.074961369713" "3.18820607199869"   "48.0128818253426" "8.74474436255827e-185"
# Residency_status2 "Chao1"      "14.0732780451513" "4.61591121108549"   "3.04886238092127" "0.00242475889881305"  
# (Intercept)       "Shannon"    "3.51492094622092" "0.0297247165242365" "118.249098973071" "0"                    
# (Intercept)       "InvSimpson" "18.214543967866"  "0.587835818922007"  "30.9857674227277" "2.59592794636019e-116"

write.table(richness_pvalues,
        file=file.path(outdir, "richness_pvalues_LinearModels.txt"),
        sep="\t",col.names = TRUE, row.names = TRUE)
```

```{r}
levels(richness$fetal_sex_binary) <- c("M", "F")

# Convert data from wide to long format for faceting
data_long <- richness %>%
  dplyr::select(Sex = fetal_sex_binary, gest_week_s, Gestation_week, Shannon, InvSimpson, Chao1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Shannon, InvSimpson, Chao1),

        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
        plot.title = element_text(
        size = 12)
  )

ggsave(file.path(plotdir, "alpha_div_over_gestation_weeks.png"), plot = last_plot(), dpi = 600,
```

## Beta diversity
```{r}
#Step 1: Calculate the Distance
ord <- ordinate(ps_css, "PCoA", "bray", weighted = TRUE
                , formula = fetal_sex_binary + bmi_s + age_s + parity_s + Residency_status + gest_week_s + fetal_sex_binary*gest_week_s)
```


```{r}
sample_data(ps_css) <- metadata_healthy

cols <- c("0" = "#50B93A", "1" = "#9C7FB9")

# Percent variance explained by PC1 and PC2
pc1_var <- round(ord$values$Relative_eig[1] * 100, 1)
pc2_var <- round(ord$values$Relative_eig[2] * 100, 1)

plot_ordination(ps_css, ord, color = "Infant_gender") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
    text = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 22),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols,
    labels = c("Male", "Female")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", pc1_var, "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", pc2_var, "%)"),
    color = "Fetal Sex"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      group = Infant_gender,
      colour = Infant_gender
    ),
    linewidth = 1.5
  )

ggsave(file.path(plotdir, "beta_div_pca.png"), plot = last_plot(), dpi = 600, 
       width = 9, height = 6, units = "in", limitsize = FALSE)
```

## Permanova

```{r}
adonis2(t(as.matrix(otu_table(ps_css))) ~ fetal_sex_binary*gest_week_s + bmi_s + age_s + parity_s + 
          Residency_status, data = metadata_healthy, method = "bray",
        permutations = 9999)

adonis_main <- adonis2(
  t(as.matrix(otu_table(ps_css))) ~
    fetal_sex_binary +
    gest_week_s +
    bmi_s +
    age_s +
    parity_s +
    Residency_status,
  data = metadata_healthy,
  method = "bray",
  permutations = 9999,
  by = "margin"
)

adonis_main

adonis_interaction <- adonis2(
  t(as.matrix(otu_table(ps_css))) ~
    fetal_sex_binary * gest_week_s +
    bmi_s +
    age_s +
    parity_s +
    Residency_status,
  data = metadata_healthy,
  method = "bray",
  permutations = 9999,
  by = "terms"
)

adonis_interaction
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
##################################################
############# main model #########################
##################################################
permanova_table <- as.data.frame(adonis_main) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !Variable %in% c("Residual", "Total")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Sum_of_squares = SumOfSqs,
    Pseudo_F = F,
    P_value = `Pr(>F)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

permanova_table <- permanova_table %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = recode(
      Variable,
      "fetal_sex_binary" = "Fetal sex",
      "gest_week_s" = "Gestational week",
      "bmi_s" = "Pre-pregnancy BMI",
      "age_s" = "Maternal age",
      "parity_s" = "Parity",
      "Residency_status" = "Residency status"
    )
  )

permanova_table_display <- permanova_table %>%
  mutate(
    R2 = round(R2, 4),
    Pseudo_F = round(Pseudo_F, 3),
    P_value = signif(P_value, 3),
    FDR = signif(FDR, 3)
  )

write.csv(
  permanova_table,
  file.path(tabledir, "PERMANOVA_BrayCurtis_results_main.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

##################################################
############# interaction model ##################
##################################################
permanova_table <- as.data.frame(adonis_interaction) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Variable") %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !Variable %in% c("Residual", "Total")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Sum_of_squares = SumOfSqs,
    Pseudo_F = F,
    P_value = `Pr(>F)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "BH"
    )
  )

permanova_table <- permanova_table %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = recode(
      Variable,
      "fetal_sex_binary" = "Fetal sex",
      "gest_week_s" = "Gestational week",
      "bmi_s" = "Pre-pregnancy BMI",
      "age_s" = "Maternal age",
      "parity_s" = "Parity",
      "Residency_status" = "Residency status",
      "fetal_sex_binary:gest_week_s" = "Fetal sex:Gestational week"
    )
  )

permanova_table_display <- permanova_table %>%
  mutate(
    R2 = round(R2, 4),
    Pseudo_F = round(Pseudo_F, 3),
    P_value = signif(P_value, 3),
    FDR = signif(FDR, 3)
  )

write.csv(
  permanova_table,
  file.path(tabledir, "PERMANOVA_BrayCurtis_results_interaction.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# maaslin2
## run maaslin2
```{r}
# ============================================================
# MaAsLin2
# Maternal gut microbiome project
#
# Primary hypotheses:
#   1. fetal sex
#   2. gestational age
#   3. fetal sex x gestational age
#
# Covariates:
#   maternal age
#   BMI before pregnancy
#   parity
#   residency status
#
# Data:
#   CSS-normalized ASV table
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# USER SETTINGS
# ============================================================

outdir <- here("data/MaasLin2/asvs_zinb_scaled")

dir.create(
  outdir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

psdir <- here("data/phyloseq")

ps_css <- readRDS(file=file.path(psdir, 'ps_css.rds'))

# Change these to the exact labels in your metadata
sex_reference <- 0
sex_comparison <- 1

# Source analysis used 0.25.
# Use the FDR threshold you have prespecified for your analysis.
fdr_cutoff <- 0.25


# ============================================================
# Helper: extract sample x feature matrix from phyloseq
# ============================================================

phyloseq_to_maaslin <- function(ps) {

  x <- as(
    otu_table(ps),
    "matrix"
  )

  if (taxa_are_rows(ps)) {
    x <- t(x)
  }

  x <- as.data.frame(
    x,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  return(x)
}

metadata_healthy <- metadata_healthy %>%
  mutate(fetal_sex_binary = as.factor(fetal_sex_binary)) %>%
  mutate(Residency_status = as.factor(Residency_status))

# ============================================================
# Check model variables
# ============================================================

model_variables <- c(
  "fetal_sex_binary",
  "gest_week_s",
  "sex_x_ega",
  "age_s",
  "bmi_s",
  "parity_s",
  "Residency_status"
)

missing_variables <- setdiff(
  model_variables,
  colnames(metadata_healthy)
)

if (length(missing_variables) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing metadata variables: ",
    paste(
      missing_variables,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

print(
  summary(
    metadata_healthy[ , model_variables],
    useNA = "ifany"
  )
)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Prepare ASV abundance table
# ============================================================

input_data <- phyloseq_to_maaslin(
  ps_css
)

# Make sure samples match
common_samples <- intersect(
  rownames(input_data),
  rownames(metadata_healthy)
)

input_data <- input_data[
  common_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

metadata_healthy <- metadata_healthy[
  common_samples,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(input_data),
    rownames(metadata_healthy)
  )
)

message(
  "Samples entering MaAsLin2: ",
  nrow(metadata_healthy)
)

message(
  "ASVs entering MaAsLin2: ",
  ncol(input_data)
)


# ============================================================
# Run MaAsLin2
#
# This preserves the settings from the original analysis:
#
# CSS data
# normalization = NONE
# transformation = NONE
# ZINB
#
# NOTE:
# I would not use this setup for PICRUSt2 functional tables.
# ============================================================

fixed_effects <- model_variables

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# No repeated-measures version
# ------------------------------------------------------------

message(
  "Running without a random effect."
)

fit_data <- Maaslin2(
  input_data = input_data,
  input_metadata = metadata_healthy,
  output = outdir,

  fixed_effects = fixed_effects,

  normalization = "NONE",
  transform = "NONE",
  analysis_method = "ZINB",

  min_prevalence = 0.25,
  standardize = FALSE,

  max_significance = fdr_cutoff,
  heatmap_first_n = 10,

  save_models = TRUE
)


# ============================================================
# Extract MaAsLin2 results
# ============================================================

fit_results <- fit_data$results

message(
  "Total MaAsLin2 coefficient tests: ",
  nrow(fit_results)
)


# ============================================================
# Extract ZINB convergence status
# ============================================================

convergence_values <- unlist(
  fit_data$fits
)

convergence_values <- convergence_values[
  grep(
    "convergence",
    names(convergence_values)
  )
]

convergence_df <- data.frame(
  feature = names(convergence_values),
  convergence_status = as.numeric(
    convergence_values
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

convergence_df$feature <- gsub(
  ".fit.convergence",
  "",
  convergence_df$feature,
  fixed = TRUE
)


# ============================================================
# Add convergence status
# ============================================================

fit_results <- fit_results %>%
  left_join(
    convergence_df,
    by = "feature"
  )


# ============================================================
# Add taxonomy
# ============================================================

taxonomy_df <- as.data.frame(
  tax_table(ps_css),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

taxonomy_df$feature <- rownames(
  taxonomy_df
)

fit_results <- fit_results %>%
  left_join(
    taxonomy_df,
    by = "feature"
  )


# ============================================================
# Add analysis metadata
# ============================================================

fit_results <- fit_results %>%
  mutate(
    normalization_used = "CSS",
    transformation_used = "NONE",
    analysis_method_used = "ZINB",
    prevalence_filter = 0.25
  )

message(
  "MaAsLin2 analysis complete."
)
```

```{r}
input_data <- data.frame(otu_table(ps_css))

# create new col in input taxa containing the lowest level
for (i in 1:nrow(input_taxa)) {
  if (input_taxa$Species[i] != "s__") {
    input_taxa$plotnames[i] = paste(input_taxa$Genus[i], input_taxa$Species[i], "(s)", sep = " ")
  } else if (input_taxa$Genus[i] != "g__") {
    input_taxa$plotnames[i] = paste(input_taxa$Genus[i], "(g)", sep = " ")
  } else if (input_taxa$Family[i] != "f__") {
    input_taxa$plotnames[i] = paste(input_taxa$Family[i], "(f)", sep = " ")
  } else if (input_taxa$Order[i] != "o__") {
    input_taxa$plotnames[i] = paste(input_taxa$Order[i], "(o)", sep = " ")
  } else if (input_taxa$Class[i] != "c__") {
    input_taxa$plotnames[i] = paste(input_taxa$Class[i], "(c)", sep = " ")
  } else if (input_taxa$Phylum[i] != "p__") {
    input_taxa$plotnames[i] = paste(input_taxa$Phylum[i], "(p)", sep = " ")
  } else {
    input_taxa$plotnames[i] = paste(input_taxa$Kingdom[i], "(k)", sep = " ")
  }
}

rm(i)
```

```{r}
asv_significance_groups <- sex_microbes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metadata = trimws(as.character(metadata))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metadata %in% c(
      "fetal_sex_binary",
      "gest_week_s",
      "sex_x_ega"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    feature,
    metadata
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig_sex = metadata == "fetal_sex_binary",
    sig_gest_week = metadata == "gest_week_s",
    sig_interaction = metadata == "sex_x_ega"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    sig_sex = any(sig_sex),
    sig_gest_week = any(sig_gest_week),
    sig_interaction = any(sig_interaction),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = dplyr::case_when(
      # Significant interaction takes priority,
      # regardless of whether main effects are also significant
      sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex x EGA interaction",

      # Sex only
      sig_sex &
        !sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex",

      # EGA only
      !sig_sex &
        sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "EGA",

      # Both main effects significant, but interaction not significant
      sig_sex &
        sig_gest_week &
        !sig_interaction ~
        "Fetal sex + EGA",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

asv_significance_groups <- asv_significance_groups %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = factor(
      significance_group,
      levels = c(
        "Fetal sex",
        "EGA",
        "Fetal sex + EGA",
        "Fetal sex x EGA interaction"
      )
    )
  )

asv_significance_groups %>%
  dplyr::count(
    significance_group,
    name = "n_asvs"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(n_asvs)
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggh4x)

all_sig_sex_int <- microbes %>%
  filter(metadata == "sex_x_ega")

asvs_to_plot <- all_sig_sex_int$feature

# don't plot gestational week coefficients 
asv_df_plot <- microbes %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    asv_significance_groups %>%
      dplyr::select(
        feature,
        significance_group
      ),
    by = "feature"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    significance_group %in% groups_to_plot
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_group = factor(
      significance_group,
      levels = groups_to_plot
    ),

    neg_log10_q = -log10(qval),

    direction = dplyr::if_else(
      coef >= 0,
      "Positive",
      "Negative"
    )
  )
# ============================================================
# 5. Extract coefficients needed to calculate
#    conditional fetal-sex effect
#
# NOTE:
# gest_week_s determines which asvs are included/grouped,
# but it is NOT part of the conditional fetal-sex equation.
#
# Conditional sex effect =
# beta_sex + beta_sex_ega * gest_week_s
# ============================================================

sex_coefficients <- microbes %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metadata = trimws(as.character(metadata)),
    feature = as.character(feature),
    coef = as.numeric(coef)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    metadata %in% c(
      "fetal_sex_binary",
      "sex_x_ega"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    feature,
    metadata,
    coef
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = metadata,
    values_from = coef
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    beta_sex = fetal_sex_binary,
    beta_sex_ega = sex_x_ega
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    feature %in% asvs_to_plot
  )

# ============================================================
# Add significance group + plotnames to sex_coefficients
# ============================================================

sex_coefficients <- sex_coefficients %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    asv_significance_groups %>%
      dplyr::select(
        feature,
        significance_group
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(),
    by = "feature"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    sex_microbes %>%
      dplyr::select(
        feature,
        plotnames
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(plotnames)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        feature,
        .keep_all = TRUE
      ),
    by = "feature"
  )

# ============================================================
# 6. Check that all selected asvs have coefficients
# ============================================================

missing_coefs <- setdiff(
  asvs_to_plot,
  sex_coefficients$feature
)

if (length(missing_coefs) > 0) {
  warning(
    length(missing_coefs),
    " selected asvs are missing sex/interaction coefficients."
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 8. Participant-level metadata
# ============================================================

participant_meta <- input_meta %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(
    "sample_id"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fetal_sex = dplyr::case_when(
      fetal_sex_binary == 0 ~ "Male",
      fetal_sex_binary == 1 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    fetal_sex = factor(
      fetal_sex,
      levels = c(
        "Male",
        "Female"
      )
    ),

    trimester = dplyr::case_when(
      Gestation_week < 14 ~
        "Trimester 1",

      Gestation_week >= 14 &
        Gestation_week < 28 ~
        "Trimester 2",

      Gestation_week >= 28 ~
        "Trimester 3",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    trimester = factor(
      trimester,
      levels = c(
        "Trimester 1",
        "Trimester 2",
        "Trimester 3"
      )
    )
  )

# # ============================================================
# # Add asv annotations/significance group to coefficient table
# # ============================================================
# 
# asv_annotation_df <- asv_df_plot %>%
#   dplyr::select(
#     feature,
#     significance_group
#   ) %>%
#   dplyr::distinct()
# 
# sex_coefficients <- sex_coefficients %>%
#   dplyr::left_join(
#     asv_annotation_df,
#     by = "feature"
#   )

# ============================================================
# 9. Generate participant-specific conditional sex effects
#
# THIS MUST BE REBUILT HERE.
#
# Do not reuse sex_effect_participant from the first
# sex_x_ega-only plot.
# ============================================================
asvs_to_plot <- sex_microbes %>%
  filter(metadata == "sex_x_ega")

sex_effect_participant <- sex_coefficients %>%
  tidyr::crossing(
    participant_meta
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    effective_sex_coef =
      beta_sex +
      beta_sex_ega * as.numeric(gest_week_s)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(trimester),
    !is.na(fetal_sex),
    !is.na(effective_sex_coef),
    !is.na(significance_group),
    !is.na(plotnames),
    significance_group == "Fetal sex x EGA interaction"
  )

# ============================================================
# 10. Verify that all significance groups are represented
# ============================================================

group_counts <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    feature,
    significance_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(
    significance_group,
    name = "n_asvs"
  )

print(group_counts)


# ============================================================
# 11. Define asv ordering
#
# Use the sex × EGA coefficient as the ordering variable
# when available.
#
# Because the plotting ID includes significance group,
# asvs remain separated correctly across facet groups.
# ============================================================

plot_order_df <- sex_coefficients %>%
  dplyr::select(
    feature,
    plotnames,
    significance_group,
    beta_sex_ega
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    significance_group,
    beta_sex_ega
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_id = paste(
      significance_group,
      feature,
      sep = "___GROUP___"
    )
  )

plot_levels <- unique(
  plot_order_df$plot_id
)


# ============================================================
# 12. Apply plotting ID/order
# ============================================================

sex_effect_participant <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    plot_id = paste(
      significance_group,
      feature,
      sep = "___GROUP___"
    ),

    plot_id = factor(
      plot_id,
      levels = plot_levels
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 13. Taxonomy display labels
# ============================================================

plot_labels <- setNames(
  plot_order_df$plotnames,
  plot_order_df$plot_id
)


# ============================================================
# 14. Calculate mean conditional effect within trimester
# ============================================================

sex_effect_participant <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    plot_id,
    trimester
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_effective_coef = mean(
      effective_sex_coef,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    mean_direction = dplyr::if_else(
      mean_effective_coef < 0,
      "Mean < 0",
      "Mean > 0"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()


# ============================================================
# Dummy data for significance-group legend
# ============================================================

legend_group_df <- sex_effect_participant %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    significance_group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(significance_group)
  )

# ============================================================
# Plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(
  sex_effect_participant,
  aes(
    x = effective_sex_coef,
    y = plot_id
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      fill = mean_direction
    ),
    width = 0.65,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    width = 0,
    height = 0.08,
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.4,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +

  # Invisible points used only to create significance-group legend
  geom_point(
    data = legend_group_df,
    aes(
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      color = significance_group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    alpha = 0
  ) +

  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    color = "darkgrey",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +

  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(significance_group),
    cols = vars(trimester),
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y",
    # strip = ggh4x::strip_themed(
    #   background_y = ggh4x::elem_list_rect(
    #     fill = unname(group_colors),
    #     color = NA
    #   ),
    #   text_y = ggh4x::elem_list_text(
    #     colour = "transparent",
    #     size = 1,
    #     hjust = 0.5,
    #     vjust = 0.5
    #   )
    # )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Mean < 0" = "#50B93A",
      "Mean > 0" = "#9C7FB9"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = group_colors,
    breaks = levels(
      sex_effect_participant$significance_group
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +

  scale_y_discrete(
    labels = plot_labels
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Conditional fetal sex effect (Female - Male)",
    y = "",
    color = "Significant association",
    fill = "Mean coefficient"
  ) +

  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      title.position = "top",
      override.aes = list(
        alpha = 1,
        size = 7,
        shape = 15
      )
    ),

    fill = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      title.position = "top",
      override.aes = list(
        size = 6
      )
    )
  ) +

  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.direction = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 16
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14
    )
  ) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 15
    ),

    strip.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),

    strip.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background.y = element_blank()
    ) +

    guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      order = 1
    ),

    color = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(
        alpha = 1,
        size = 5,
        shape = 15
      )
    )
  )

  # theme(
  #   axis.text.y = element_text(
  #     size = 11
  #   ),
  # 
  #   axis.text.x = element_text(
  #     size = 11
  #   ),
  # 
  #   axis.title.x = element_text(
  #     size = 13
  #   ),
  # 
  #   strip.text = element_text(
  #     size = 12,
  #     face = "bold"
  #   ),
  # 
  #   legend.title = element_text(
  #     size = 12
  #   ),
  # 
  #   legend.text = element_text(
  #     size = 11
  #   )
  # )

p


ggsave(file.path(plotdir, "ECs_sex_adjusted_box_per_tri.png"), plot = p, dpi = 600, 
       width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", limitsize = FALSE)
```
